3e375611.diff:
--- a/computer_use_control.py+++ b/computer_use_control.py@@ -6,10 +6,171 @@ 
 from typing import Any, Dict
 import threading
+import platform
+import subprocess
+import os
+import re
 
 _execution_lock = threading.Lock()
 
 from ..tool_registry import Tool, register
+
+
+def get_active_window() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Get the currently active foreground window with title, process name, and PID.
+    Works on Windows (ctypes), macOS (AppKit), and Linux (X11/wmctrl)."""
+    system = platform.system()
+    try:
+        if system == "Windows":
+            import ctypes
+            from ctypes import wintypes
+            user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
+            hwnd = user32.GetForegroundWindow()
+            if not hwnd:
+                return {"title": "", "process_name": "", "process_id": 0}
+            length = user32.GetWindowTextLengthW(hwnd) + 1
+            buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(length)
+            user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, length)
+            title = buf.value
+            pid = wintypes.DWORD()
+            user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, ctypes.byref(pid))
+            # Get process name from PID
+            try:
+                import psutil
+                proc = psutil.Process(pid.value)
+                process_name = proc.name()
+            except ImportError:
+                # fallback: use tasklist
+                result = subprocess.run(
+                    ["tasklist", "/FI", f"PID eq {pid.value}", "/FO", "CSV", "/NH"],
+                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5
+                )
+                if result.returncode == 0:
+                    parts = result.stdout.strip().strip('"').split('","')
+                    process_name = parts[0] if parts else ""
+                else:
+                    process_name = ""
+            return {"title": title or "", "process_name": process_name or "", "process_id": pid.value}
+        elif system == "Darwin":
+            script = """
+tell application "System Events"
+    set frontApp to first application process whose frontmost is true
+    set appName to name of frontApp
+    set pid to unix id of frontApp
+end tell
+tell application appName
+    if (count of windows) > 0 then
+        set winTitle to name of front window
+    else
+        set winTitle to ""
+    end if
+end tell
+return {appName, pid, winTitle}
+"""
+            result = subprocess.run(["osascript", "-e", script], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
+            if result.returncode == 0:
+                parts = [p.strip() for p in result.stdout.split(",")]
+                if len(parts) >= 3:
+                    return {
+                        "title": parts[2].strip() or "",
+                        "process_name": parts[0].strip() or "",
+                        "process_id": int(parts[1].strip() or 0)
+                    }
+            return {"title": "", "process_name": "", "process_id": 0}
+        elif system == "Linux":
+            # Try xdotool first (fastest)
+            try:
+                result = subprocess.run(
+                    ["xdotool", "getactivewindow", "getactivewindow", "getwindowname", "getactivewindow", "getwindowpid"],
+                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3
+                )
+                if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip():
+                    lines = result.stdout.strip().split("\n")
+                    if len(lines) >= 2:
+                        title = lines[0] if len(lines) > 0 else ""
+                        try:
+                            pid = int(lines[1].strip())
+                        except ValueError:
+                            pid = 0
+                        # Get process name from /proc
+                        try:
+                            with open(f"/proc/{pid}/comm", "r") as f:
+                                process_name = f.read().strip()
+                        except (FileNotFoundError, PermissionError):
+                            process_name = ""
+                        return {"title": title, "process_name": process_name, "process_id": pid}
+            except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
+                pass
+            # Fallback: wmctrl
+            try:
+                result = subprocess.run(
+                    ["wmctrl", "-lx", "-p", "-u"],
+                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3
+                )
+                if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip():
+                    # Format: window_id desktop_id pid (after sorting, first = active)
+                    lines = result.stdout.strip().split("\n")
+                    if lines:
+                        # wmctrl -u returns only the active window; if not, sort by desktop
+                        if len(lines) == 1:
+                            parts = lines[0].split(None, 3)
+                            if len(parts) >= 3:
+                                try:
+                                    pid = int(parts[2])
+                                except ValueError:
+                                    pid = 0
+                                title = parts[3] if len(parts) > 3 else ""
+                                # Extract process name from window class (parts[1] is class.class)
+                                win_class = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
+                                process_name = win_class.split(".")[0] if "." in win_class else win_class
+                                return {"title": title, "process_name": process_name, "process_id": pid}
+            except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
+                pass
+            # Final fallback: /proc via xprop
+            try:
+                result = subprocess.run(
+                    ["xprop", "-root", "_NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW"],
+                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3
+                )
+                if result.returncode == 0:
+                    match = re.search(r"window id # (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)", result.stdout)
+                    if match:
+                        win_id = match.group(1)
+                        # Get title
+                        title_result = subprocess.run(
+                            ["xprop", "-id", win_id, "_NET_WM_NAME"],
+                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3
+                        )
+                        title = ""
+                        if title_result.returncode == 0:
+                            m = re.search(r'"(.+)"', title_result.stdout)
+                            if m:
+                                title = m.group(1)
+                        # Get PID
+                        pid_result = subprocess.run(
+                            ["xprop", "-id", win_id, "_NET_WM_PID"],
+                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3
+                        )
+                        pid = 0
+                        if pid_result.returncode == 0:
+                            m = re.search(r"= (\d+)", pid_result.stdout)
+                            if m:
+                                pid = int(m.group(1))
+                        process_name = ""
+                        if pid > 0:
+                            try:
+                                with open(f"/proc/{pid}/comm", "r") as f:
+                                    process_name = f.read().strip()
+                            except (FileNotFoundError, PermissionError):
+                                pass
+                        return {"title": title, "process_name": process_name, "process_id": pid}
+            except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
+                pass
+            return {"title": "", "process_name": "", "process_id": 0}
+        else:
+            return {"title": "", "process_name": "", "process_id": 0}
+    except Exception as e:
+        return {"title": "", "process_name": "", "process_id": 0, "error": str(e)}

@@ -42,12 +203,15 @@             cu.set_stop(True)

@@ -251,9 +254,72 @@     except Exception as e:

+def get_active_window_title() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """
+    Get the title of the currently active (foreground) window.
+
+    Uses platform-specific mechanisms:
+      - Windows: ctypes GetForegroundWindow + GetWindowText
+      - Linux:   xdotool getactivewindow getwindowname
+      - macOS:   osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true'
+
+    Returns:
+        dict with keys:
+          - success (bool): True if title was obtained successfully
+          - title (str): The window title, or "unknown" on failure
+    """
+    platform = sys.platform
+    try:
+        if platform == "win32":
+            # Windows: use ctypes to call user32
+            user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
+            hwnd = user32.GetForegroundWindow()
+            length = user32.GetWindowTextLengthW(hwnd)
+            if length == 0:
+                # No text (e.g. desktop) return unknown gracefully
+                return {"success": True, "title": "unknown"}
+            buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(length + 1)
+            user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, length + 1)
+            title = buf.value
+            return {"success": True, "title": title} if title else {"success": True, "title": "unknown"}
+        elif platform == "linux":
+            # Linux: xdotool (commonly available, no extra deps)
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                ["xdotool", "getactivewindow", "getwindowname"],
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                timeout=2
+            )
+            if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip():
+                return {"success": True, "title": result.stdout.strip()}
+            else:
+                # Fallback for headless/no X11
+                return {"success": False, "title": "unknown"}
+        elif platform == "darwin":
+            # macOS: osascript
+            script = (
+                'tell application "System Events" to set frontApp to name of first process '
+                'whose frontmost is true'
+            )
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                ["osascript", "-e", script],
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                timeout=2
+            )
+            if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip():
+                return {"success": True, "title": result.stdout.strip()}
+            else:
+                return {"success": False, "title": "unknown"}
+        else:
+            return {"success": False, "title": "unknown", "error": f"Unsupported platform: {platform}"}
+    except Exception as e:
+        return {"success": False, "title": "unknown", "error": str(e)}
+
+
 TOOL = Tool(
     name="screen_ops",
-    summary="Screen operations - take screenshots, capture regions, locate images, get screen info, pixel colors",
+    summary="Screen operations - take screenshots, capture regions, locate images, get screen info, pixel colors, active window title",
